scope: Independent static scientific/transport review and generated or metadata-only checks before new CT pixel access.

independent_geometry_check.method: Inverse-affine midpoint plus absolute inverse-matrix halfextent; independent Cartesian chunk enumeration.

independent_generated_sampling_check.field: Analytic quadratic plus linear XYZ terms, under a sheared affine; no CT source.
independent_generated_sampling_check.expected_quadrature_correction_formula: 0.08 * trace(M.T @ H @ M), M=inverse affine linear part

static_findings: All source support is derived from fixed old centers and the unchanged published affine; no fit or region replacement is performed.
New source objects are admitted from a complete HEAD snapshot before any body; old identities must retain ETag and length, and new objects must satisfy per-object and cumulative limits.
Metadata hashes pass before raw GETs; imported acquisition code pins If-Match, exact status/length/ETag, records failures, bounds I/O and validates Blosc decoded size.
Prior canonical acquisition receipts and old source/array hashes are checked before decoding or acquiring new CT.
Both sites must reproduce old central33 fine arrays within1e-8 counts and old central35 native arrays exactly before new anatomical metrics are computed.
All 27 declared shifts are retained on each nested support; finite65 smoothing has complete81 support, and outer-shell data are reported separately.
Constant variance retention is undefined when raw support is constant; exact-constant descriptive mean/SD are handled explicitly.
Resource totals preserve original14 objects and add only43 new objects; six target objects are reused.
The protocol and README explicitly retain adaptive selection and prohibit anatomical, label-transfer and ink-improvement certification from correlation alone.
limits: This pre-pixel review does not verify future server responses or real-data outcomes.
Nested supports and outer shells are related development measurements, not independent trials.
High surrounding correlation cannot certify the original central patch, material identity, physical face or same-sheet correspondence.
The125-midpoint nominal-footprint approximation does not reproduce the actual scanner PSF.
